description: Corrected allelic series for SERPINA6 using primary-source binding data, and the mass-action compensation measured directly in the original CBG Lyon proband
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# A. CBG Lyon index case, Emptoz-Bonneton 2000 (PMID 10634411)
#    43-year-old woman, chronic asthenia and hypotension.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
tot_pt_lo, tot_pt_hi = 22.0, 61.0          # nmol/L, repeated morning cortisol
tot_ref_lo, tot_ref_hi = 204.0, 546.0      # nmol/L reference
free_pct_pt_lo, free_pct_pt_hi = 8.7, 9.7  # % dialysable
free_pct_ref_lo, free_pct_ref_hi = 2.9, 3.9

tot_pt = (tot_pt_lo + tot_pt_hi)/2
tot_ref = (tot_ref_lo + tot_ref_hi)/2
fp_pt = (free_pct_pt_lo + free_pct_pt_hi)/2
fp_ref = (free_pct_ref_lo + free_pct_ref_hi)/2

free_pt, free_ref = tot_pt*fp_pt/100, tot_ref*fp_ref/100

print("=== CBG Lyon index case (PMID 10634411) ===")
print(f"Total cortisol      : {tot_pt:6.1f} vs {tot_ref:6.1f} nmol/L   ratio {tot_pt/tot_ref:.3f}  ({(1-tot_pt/tot_ref)*100:.0f}% reduction)")
print(f"Free fraction       : {fp_pt:6.1f} vs {fp_ref:6.1f} %        ratio {fp_pt/fp_ref:.2f}  ({fp_pt/fp_ref:.1f}-fold rise)")
print(f"Free cortisol       : {free_pt:6.2f} vs {free_ref:6.2f} nmol/L   ratio {free_pt/free_ref:.3f}")
print(f"Serum CBG           :   24.0 vs   44.0 mg/L     ratio {24/44:.3f}")
print(f"Association const Ka:   0.12 vs   0.82 L/nmol   ratio {0.12/0.82:.3f}  ({0.82/0.12:.1f}-fold loss)")
print(f"\nCompensation index  : free ratio / total ratio = {(free_pt/free_ref)/(tot_pt/tot_ref):.2f}")
print("ACTH and 24 h urinary cortisol were both normal, so the HPA axis is intact.")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# B. Corrected allelic series. Recombinant data (PMID 22948765) show the
#    variant PROTEIN is dead; heterozygote serum shows ~50% capacity
#    because half the molecules are wild type.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
series = [
  # name,                class,      ELISA CBG %, binding capacity %, recombinant protein activity
  ("CBG null, heterozygote",      "quantity",  50,  50, "n/a"),
  ("CBG null, HOMOZYGOTE (n=3)",  "quantity",   0,   0, "n/a"),
  ("CBG Santiago het (L5Cfs*26)", "quantity",  50,  50, "n/a"),
  ("CBG Montevideo het",          "quantity",  50,  50, "n/a"),
  ("CBG Lyon D367N het",          "quality",  100,  50, "zero"),
  ("CBG Leuven L93H het",         "quality",  100,  65, "reduced"),
  ("CBG Athens W371S het",        "quality",  100,  50, "zero"),
  ("Athens/Lyon compound het",    "quality",  100,   0, "zero"),
  ("CBG A224S (S246A) polymorph", "neutral",  100, 100, "normal"),
]
print("\n=== Corrected allelic series ===")
print(f"{'Variant':<30} {'class':<9} {'ELISA %':>8} {'binding %':>10}  recombinant")
for nm, cl, el, bc, rec in series:
    print(f"{nm:<30} {cl:<9} {el:>8} {bc:>10}  {rec}")

print("\nThe dissociation that matters diagnostically:")
print("  CBG Lyon / Athens heterozygotes: ELISA 100% of reference, binding capacity 50%.")
print("  Immunoassay alone reports these patients as entirely normal.")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Figure
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5.4))

ax = axes[0]
cats = ["Total cortisol", "Free fraction (%)", "Free cortisol", "Serum CBG", "CBG affinity (Ka)"]
ratios = [tot_pt/tot_ref, fp_pt/fp_ref, free_pt/free_ref, 24/44, 0.12/0.82]
cols = ["#C44E52", "#55A868", "#DD8452", "#4C72B0", "#4C72B0"]
b = ax.bar(cats, ratios, color=cols, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.6)
ax.axhline(1.0, color="black", ls="--", lw=1.2)
for xi, v in enumerate(ratios):
    ax.text(xi, v+0.08, f"{v:.2f}", ha="center", fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylabel("Patient value / reference value")
ax.set_ylim(0, 3.0)
ax.set_xticklabels(cats, rotation=20, ha="right", fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("A. CBG Lyon index case: total cortisol falls 89%,\n"
             "but the free fraction rises 2.6-fold so free cortisol is near normal", fontsize=10)

ax = axes[1]
cmap = {"quantity":"#4C72B0", "quality":"#DD8452", "neutral":"#999999"}
names = [s[0] for s in series]
y = np.arange(len(series)); h = 0.38
ax.barh(y-h/2, [s[2] for s in series], h, label="CBG by immunoassay (ELISA)",
        color=[cmap[s[1]] for s in series], edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.5)
ax.barh(y+h/2, [s[3] for s in series], h, label="cortisol-binding capacity",
        color=[cmap[s[1]] for s in series], edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.5,
        hatch="///", alpha=0.72)
ax.axvline(100, color="black", ls=":", lw=1)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(names, fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlabel("Percent of reference value")
ax.set_xlim(0, 118); ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower right")
ax.set_title("B. Quality-defect alleles are invisible to immunoassay:\n"
             "normal ELISA, half the binding capacity", fontsize=10)

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
